text:
Nina R.: Quick sync idea from today's postmortem review: define a hard lifecycle for action items so they don't languish. Current free-form "rows in a doc" approach is failing.

Carlos V.: Agree. What lifecycle states are you thinking?

Nina R.: Minimal set: Proposed -> Assigned -> In Progress -> Verifying -> Closed. Each transition needs a timestamp and an evidence link for closure.

Tess - oncall: love that. Could we require VerificationOwner and VerificationDeadline when moving to Verifying? Means QA or oncall validates changes.

Ryan (SRE lead): Also add an "Owner Change" rule: if owner OOO >5 business days, auto-assign to team backup and notify original owner on return. We lose continuity otherwise.

incident-bot: [automated] I can enforce state machine rules if actions live as issues in our tracker. Config required: state_order, notify_on_state_change, backups_map.

Nina R.: Proposal doc snippet (copyable):
```
Fields: Action | Owner | BackupOwner | State | Created | Due | SLA_hours | VerificationOwner | VerificationDeadline | EvidenceLink | RecurrenceTag | Confidence
State transitions: Proposed -> Assigned (owner ack within 48h) -> In Progress -> Verifying -> Closed
Rules:
- Owner must ack within 48h of Assigned
- If SLA_hours exceeded, escalate to BackupOwner -> Team Lead -> IC
- VerificationDeadline <= Due + 7 days
```

Carlos V.: If we use Jira, incident-bot can create subtasks for actions and enforce transitions with webhooks. If spreadsheet, we lose automation. Tradeoffs?

Tess - oncall: Spreadsheet is faster to pilot, but Jira gives audit trail. Maybe pilot spreadsheet but require that every action has a linked Jira ticket if SLA>72h. That keeps automation where it matters.

Ryan (SRE lead): good middle ground. Also: comms cadence: initial owner assignment email within 24h, weekly digest of overdue items, and monthly rollup of recurrence tags for leadership.

Nina R.: rotation proposal: 3-week IC rotation with 1-week overlap. Rotation IC is responsible for weekly triage of actions and triggering escalations. Calendar invite template: Subject: IC Rotation - Week of YYYY-MM-DD / Body: review board link + top 5 overdue items + handover notes.

Tess - oncall: I'll script a Slack workflow that posts top-5 overdue each Monday and pings backup owners. incident-bot can create the Jira subtasks for items that hit SLA>72h.

incident-bot: [automated] Posting weekly overdue digest -> Mondays 10:00 UTC. Creating Jira subtasks when configured conditions met.

Carlos V.: One more: recurrence detection algorithm: tag a recurrence if same RecurrenceTag appears in >=3 incidents in last 180 days OR same service appears in >=4 incidents. Flag as "systemic" and require a root-cause audit within 30 days.

Nina R.: And measurement: track closure rates at 7/30/90 days + mean time to verification. We'll run this pilot for 12 incidents and review results.

Tess - oncall: I'll stand up a pilot sheet and the Slack workflow by next Tuesday (1853080000). Will post link and add folks as editors.

Ryan (SRE lead): I'll nominate backups for each team and own the "systemic" audit policy. Let's try to keep the initial template small so teams adopt it.

Nina R.: Thanks. If you want to join the pilot, DM @Tess or react to this thread. :white_check_mark:
